task_text: A photographer is coming in 15 minutes to shoot the apartment for a listing. Every room should look immaculate — brightly lit, surfaces clear, everything neatly arranged, and any trash or clutter out of sight.

central_instructions.R1: Clear and organize all light objects in the kitchen, ensuring surfaces are tidy and well-lit.
central_instructions.R2: Tidy up the living room by arranging light objects neatly and ensuring the area is well-lit.
central_instructions.R3: Organize the bedroom by arranging both light and heavy objects, and ensure furniture is properly positioned.
central_instructions.R4: Ensure the bathroom is tidy by clearing light objects and arranging them neatly.

agent_plans.R1:
[0-5 min]
- R1 [LOCAL] Pick up the empty bottle from the table and place it in the recycling bin. (r1_s1)
- R1 [LOCAL] Pick up the cup from the table and place it in the cupboard. (r1_s2)

[5-10 min]
- R1 [LOCAL] Pick up the plate from the table and place it in the cupboard. (r1_s3)
- R1 [LOCAL] Pick up the bowl from the counter and place it in the cupboard. (r1_s4)

[10-15 min]
- R1 [LOCAL] Adjust the position of the toaster to align neatly with the counter edge. (r1_s5)
- R1 [LOCAL] Ensure all lights are turned on for optimal brightness. (r1_s6)
agent_plans.R2:
[0-5 min]
- R2 [LOCAL] Arrange magazines and books neatly on the coffee table. (r2_s1)
- R2 [LOCAL] Pick up any small clutter items from the floor and place them in the trash bin. (r2_s2)

[5-10 min]
- R2 [LOCAL] Adjust the position of the lamp to ensure optimal lighting in the room. (r2_s3)
- R2 [LOCAL] Straighten the cushions on the sofa for a tidy appearance. (r2_s4)

[10-15 min]
- R2 [LOCAL] Ensure all light objects are neatly arranged on the side tables. (r2_s5)
- R2 [LOCAL] Double-check the lighting and make any final adjustments for brightness. (r2_s6)
agent_plans.R3:
[0-5 min]
- R3 [LOCAL] Pick up any clutter or trash from the floor and surfaces. (r3_s1)
- R3 [LOCAL] Arrange pillows neatly on the bed. (r3_s2)

[5-10 min]
- R3 [LOCAL] Push the chair to align it neatly with the wall. (r3_s3)
- R3 [LOCAL] Organize items on the dresser and shelves, ensuring surfaces are clear. (r3_s4)

[10-15 min]
- R3 [LOCAL] Adjust the bedspread to ensure it is smooth and tidy. (r3_s5)
- R3 [LOCAL] Ensure all lights are turned on for bright lighting. (r3_s6)
agent_plans.R4:
[0-5 min]
- R4 [LOCAL] Pick up the toothbrush and toothpaste from the sink area and place them neatly on the counter. (r4_s1)

[5-10 min]
- R4 [LOCAL] Pick up any small trash items from the floor and place them in the trash bin. (r4_s2)

[10-15 min]
- R4 [LOCAL] Arrange the towel neatly on the towel rack. (r4_s3)
